entries.title: Bringing AI to the device: Edge AI chips come into their own
entries.quote: We predict that in 2020, more than 750 million edge AI chips—chips or parts of chips that perform or accelerate machine learning tasks on-device, rather than in a remote data center—will be sold.
entries.subject: Edge AI chips
entries.note: Quote joined from the chapter opening, which the PDF text splits across columns.

entries.title: Robots on the move: Professional service robots set for double-digit growth
entries.quote: we predict that just over half of them will be professional service robots, generating more than US$16 billion in revenue—30 percent more than in 2019.
entries.subject: Professional service robots
entries.note: Press release: professional service robots pass industrial robots in units in 2020 and in revenue in 2021.

entries.title: Private 5G networks: Enterprise untethered
entries.quote: We expect that more than 100 companies worldwide will have begun testing private 5G deployments by the end of 2020, collectively investing a few hundred million dollars in labor and equipment.
entries.subject: Private 5G networks

entries.title: High speed from low orbit: A broadband revolution or a bunch of space junk?
entries.quote: By the end of 2020, there would be over 700 satellites in low-earth orbit (LEO) seeking to offer global broadband internet, up from roughly 200 at the end of 2019.
entries.metric: broadband satellites in low earth orbit
entries.subject: LEO satellite broadband
entries.note: Quote from the Deloitte press release summary (as reported), not the report text; the chapter number was not isolated in the PDF text.

entries.title: The smartphone multiplier: Toward a trillion-dollar economy
entries.quote: We predict that the smartphone multiplier will drive US$459 billion of revenue in 2020 alone.
entries.metric: revenue driven by the smartphone multiplier (accessories, apps, ads)
entries.subject: Smartphone ecosystem revenue

entries.title: My antennae are tingling: Terrestrial TV's surprising staying power
entries.quote: We predict that in 2020, at least 1.6 billion people worldwide, representing 450 million households, will get at least some of their TV from an antenna.
entries.metric: people getting some TV from an antenna
entries.subject: Antenna (terrestrial) TV

entries.title: Coming to a CDN near you: Videos, games, and much, much more
entries.quote: We predict that the global CDN market will reach US$14 billion in 2020, up more than 25 percent from 2019's estimated US$11 billion.
entries.subject: Content delivery networks

entries.title: Ad-supported video: Will the United States follow Asia's lead?
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that revenue from ad-supported video services will reach an estimated US$32 billion in 2020.
entries.subject: Ad-supported video on demand

entries.title: The ears have it: The rise of audiobooks and podcasting
entries.quote: In 2020, Deloitte predicts, the global audiobook market will grow by 25 percent to US$3.5 billion. We also predict that the global podcasting market will increase by 30 percent to reach US$1.1 billion in 2020
entries.subject: Audiobooks and podcasts

entries.title: Cycling's technological transformation: Making bicycling faster, easier, and safer
entries.quote: We predict that tens of billions of additional bicycle trips per year will take place in 2022 over 2019 levels.
entries.metric: additional bicycle trips per year vs 2019
entries.subject: Cycling and e-bikes
entries.note: Press release adds: more than 130 million e-bikes sold between 2020 and 2023.

notes: 19th edition (Deloitte press release, 10 December 2019). The Deloitte Insights edition URL serves the full report PDF. Rank is the order in the report.
